title: Whiskey Cavalier
premise_summary: Whiskey Cavalier is an American action comedy-drama television series, created by David Hemingson, that premiered on February 24, 2019. The full pilot episode debuted after the Oscars and was rebroadcast in the show’s regular time slot three nights later, on ABC. On May 12, 2019, ABC cancelled the series after one season, and the series finale aired on May 22, 2019.
